testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate to template group endpoints with Home and End ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-group-endpoints-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its native catalog contains the named part and assembly templates used below ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons ✔ And the Part group begins with Sheet Metal (DIN) and ends with Standard (mm) ✔ And the Assembly group begins with Mold Design (DIN) and ends with Weldment (JIS) ✔ When the user selects Sheet Metal (mm) in the Part group ✔ And the user presses Home ✔ Then Sheet Metal (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane ✔ When the user presses End ✔ Then Standard (mm) is selected and identified in the details pane ✔ When the user selects Mold Design (mm) in the Assembly group ✔ And the user presses End ✔ Then Weldment (JIS) is selected and identified in the details pane ✔ When the user presses Home ✔ Then Mold Design (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
